channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: Israel airstrikes hit Beirut after Hezbollah fires rockets, drones
item.description: Israeli jets carried out airstrikes on Lebanon’s capital, Beirut, after Hezbollah launched rocket and drone attacks on a military base in Israel, media reports said on Monday.

item.title: Karzai, Abdullah extend condolences on Khamenei’s death
item.description: Former Afghan President Hamid Karzai and former head of the High Council for Peace Dr. Abdullah Abdullah expressed sorrow over the reported killing of Iran’s leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Hundreds of Afghan refugees arrested as Pakistan intensifies crackdown
item.description: Hundreds of Afghan refugees have been arrested in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa amid an intensified crackdown on undocumented foreign migrants in Pakistan, media reports said on Monday.

item.title: Hundreds of shops closed in Ghazni amid hoarding, price hikes
item.description: The municipality has closed hundreds of shops in the capital of southern Ghazni province following a sudden rise in food prices, citing the ongoing conflict in Iran as a pretext.

item.title: UN declares 2026 as ‘International Year of Women Farmers’
item.description: The United Nations has designated 2026 as the “International Year of Women Farmers,” emphasising the decisive role of women in ensuring global food security and economic growth.

item.title: Several US jets crash in Kuwait: Defence ministry
item.description: The Ministry of Defence of Kuwait has confirmed that several US warplanes crashed on Monday morning, with all crew members reported unharmed, according to media reports.

item.title: 4 killed, 5 wounded in Jawzjan collision
item.description: At least four people, including a woman, were killed and five others wounded in a traffic accident in northern Jawzjan province on Monday, an official said.

item.title: Afghanistan to tour India for one-off Test, 3 ODIs in June
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): The Afghanistan National Cricket Team is set to tour India in June for a one-off Test match and a three-match One-Day International (ODI)

item.title: US embassy in Saudi capital hit by drones
item.description: The United States Embassy in Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia, was hit by two Iranian drones on Tuesday, a media report said.

item.title: 34 martyred, 89 injured in Pakistani attacks on Afghanistan in 4 days: UN
item.description: The United Nations says at least 34 civilians were martyred and 89 others injured in Pakistani military attacks inside Afghanistan from February 26 to March 1.
